statements.text: But who is doing the sort of ethical and moral implications of the AI incorporation into the Department of Defense? Who owns that?
statements.context: Question posed during a House Armed Services Committee hearing on the Defense Intelligence Enterprise's posture in strategic competition with China.

statements.text: Local communities must always have a seat at the table. Federal agencies should work with local governments, utility providers, tribal communities where appropriate, and residents before major projects move forward. I support a one-year moratorium in Michigan on building new AI Data centers, until we can ensure the impacts are understood and local townships and counties can put proper regulations in place that protect our communities.

Michigan families should not subsidize massive data centers through higher utility bills. I have consistently fought federal policies that drive up energy costs and threaten grid reliability. [...] Any data center should pay its own way, including the generation and infrastructure necessary to serve it, rather than shifting those costs onto families, farms, and small businesses.
